---
title: Spaghetti With Fresh Tuna
id: MAR-0114
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g of spaghetti
- 200 g of tuna fillet
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 1 onion
- 1 tablespoon of pine nuts
- 20 g of basil leaves
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the onion and cut it into small dice.
2. Cut the tuna into 2 cm dice and brown it in a pan with half the oil for one minute, then lower the heat, remove the tuna draining it, add the onion with the pine nuts to the pan and let it wilt for 7-8 minutes.
3. Add the tuna to the onion and salt lightly.
4. Cook the pasta, drain it, pour it into the pan and mix in the remaining oil; distribute onto plates finishing with the snipped basil leaves.
